guard: a refused host renewal preserves the actual held driver and mediator pair across the drained refusal boundary

mutations.name: refused renewal replaces the last-good driver with the mediator
mutations.find: run.renewalDebt = { at: Date.now(), reason: (e as Error).message };
mutations.replace:
run.creds = run.mediatorCreds;
        run.renewalDebt = { at: Date.now(), reason: (e as Error).message };
mutations.expectRed: ✗ FAIL: 4a. Refused renewRunDriver keeps the held last-good driver/mediator (same nkey and exp) and records debt
mutations.cell: 4a. Refused renewRunDriver keeps the held last-good driver/mediator (same nkey and exp) and records debt
